title: Influencer Marketing Agency Guide: What You Get, What It Costs, and How to Vet One
summary: What an influencer marketing agency actually does, what the $5,000-$6,000 monthly retainer buys, how to vet one for fake followers, and when in-house or a platform beats an agency.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


### Is an influencer marketing agency worth $5,000-$6,000 a month?


Demand a forecast with visible assumptions, then compare it against actual results.


### How do I vet an influencer marketing agency so I don't get burned?


Vet an influencer marketing agency by asking for concrete monthly deliverables, not broad promises. A credible plan specifies a creator shortlist, outreach volume, signed agreements, approved content, live posts, and a performance report. Also confirm which tasks the agency owns, which decisions stay with you, and how results get measured before signing a retainer.


### What should an influencer marketing agency actually deliver every month?


A strong influencer marketing agency delivers five services each month: strategy, sourcing, negotiation, production coordination, and reporting. Each task should connect to a business outcome, from defined campaign goals to tracked measures like reach, engagement, conversions, and cost per acquisition. Ask exactly which production and paid media tasks sit inside the retainer and which get billed separately.


### How much do influencer marketing agencies charge in NYC?


Choose local support when your campaign depends on in-person production or local creator access; otherwise, prioritize relevant experience and clear deliverables over proximity and compare against a remote team's scope.


### Do influencer marketing agencies charge a percentage of ad spend?


When a fee scales with media investment, calculate the total cost including creator compensation, product, shipping, paid promotion, and internal labor. Ask whether unused media budget or hours carry forward before committing.


### What do I keep in-house when hiring an influencer marketing agency?


Your company keeps ownership of product claims, brand voice, inventory readiness, customer experience, and final approval when hiring an influencer marketing agency. Assign an internal decision-maker to review briefs, resolve legal questions, and give timely feedback. Legal review belongs in the workflow: 93% of marketers require legal review of influencer agreements.


### Should I hire an agency or use a TikTok Shop affiliate platform?


A TikTok Shop affiliate platform gives you direct control over creator discovery and affiliate operations at a lower cost than a recurring agency fee. Reacher ranks a database of more than 4 million TikTok Shop creators and runs outreach across DM, Target Collab, and email at up to 10,000 creators a day. Choose an agency when you want managed expertise and execution, a platform when you want to run the program in-house at scale.
